bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive only: development reuse, dependence across games/teams/time and historical knowledge contamination invalidate strong independent out-of-sample interpretations. No significance-based winner selection or tuning.
bootstrap.procedure: Python random.Random(seed); draw n row indices with replacement per replicate; share those indices across all five comparisons; take mean paired per-game Brier differences; percentile interval at 0.025 and 0.975 using linear (n-1)*q interpolation. No model refits or new calls.
bootstrap.unit: game on identical complete five-method intersection

calibration.bins: Existing ten equal-width bins, final bin includes 1; preserve every count including zero
calibration.confidence: Mean max(p,1-p), observed accuracy using p>=0.5 as home classification, their gap, mean abs(p-0.5), and number p<=0.1 or p>=0.9. Small bins are descriptive only; shrinkage necessarily moves p toward 0.5 and does not establish calibration improvement.

contributions.leave_one_group_out: Existing deterministic recomputation only; same full-model paired IDs; report omission-minus-full Brier and log loss
contributions.summary: Report successful inferred log-LRs separately from full-forecast log-LRs including legitimate missing-group zeros. On the shared paired intersection, report signed contributions and abs(full p-0.5)-abs(omission p-0.5), for each alpha.

directionality.criterion: Strict dominance using supplied season win fraction and average point differential: home weaker if both are strictly lower; away weaker if both are strictly higher. Ties, discordant indicators, unavailable/nonfinite statistics or zero completed games are unassessable. Flag successful A LR>1 for weaker home, or LR<1 for weaker away. Never adjust or exclude a forecast.

lr_statistics.extreme_rule: Existing frozen flag: LR<=0.1 or LR>=10; validation bounds remain [0.05,20]
lr_statistics.neutral_comparison: Exact LR equality to 1; exclude missing-group LR=1 from inferred-neutral counts
lr_statistics.quantile_rule: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; population standard deviation

scope: Existing fixed 50 development games only; no reserved outcome inspection or inference

stratification.injuries: Use pre-inference C.usable, separately from inference success/failure. Within each stratum compare all five methods on the same eligible intersection; report excluded IDs and group failure/source missingness separately.
stratification.sufficiency: Per group adequate versus limited counts, LR/log-LR distributions, and paired full-forecast scores with stratum n. Labels are model judgments, not source verification; no causal interpretation.
